title: Mixed Event — Beyond The Dream of That Day — Episode3 A Surprise Request

meta.Event: Beyond The Dream of That Day
meta.Event Outline: After putting on a successful solo show, MORE MORE JUMP! starts thinking about their next goal. During that time, they're offered a chance to appear on TV. Everyone is excited to hear the news, except Haruka, who doesn't quite share in their optimism...

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, now that we've decided to try to become top idols in order to be able to perform at the Dome...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll need to start thinking about how we're actually going to accomplish that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right!
Performing at the Dome's way in the future...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Until then, we should probably perform in shows at increasingly bigger venues. Those should work as stepping stones, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, about that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We were actually thinking that we may be able to put on a show at a slightly bigger venue.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
For example, Shibuya Hall.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? Shibuya Hall...? As in THE Shibuya Hall?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That'd be amazing...!
We'd be able to perform in front of so many people!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: At the same time, if we think we can fill 2,000 seats, we could start aiming a little higher.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Higher...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We have a big dream now, so if we are aiming to have 10,000 guests... That's about how many the Ryogoku Sumo Arena or Nonogi Gymnasium seat.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: 15,000 would mean the Butokan.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The Butokan...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Someone said that they want to see us perform there, right...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Us performing there would mean making their dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
So, I want to aim for that.
If we're going to perform at the Dome, we should try to perform at the Butokan first.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
15,000 people...
It's a huge number, but that's what we gotta go for if we want to be #1!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But that means we'll need to figure out a way to increase our audience size from 700 to 15,000.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How do we actually go about doing that...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our fan base should grow as long as we keep doing streams... However, 15,000 is going to be difficult to reach based on our current rate.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Does that mean we have to start rethinking how we do our streams? Especially since that one article gave us such a big boost!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We have a few options to choose from now, including magazines, radio...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
That's right. We got some offers for work!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, we did...
Those may benefit us quite a bit!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I agree for the most part...
However, we should do some research on each company before we accept any offers.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right.
We received a lot of messages, but some seemed pretty sketchy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Why don't we take this opportunity to go through them and get ourselves organized...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay...!
This is so exciting! I can't wait to see who's been trying to reach us since I haven't had a chance to look through all of them...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll check the emails. Minori, can you take the DMs? Airi, if you could look through the comments for our streams...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And Shizuku...
Would you mind assisting Minori and Airi?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I get to be their assistant?
That sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Alright, Shizuku, I'm gonna need all the help you can give me!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Airi, Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
Yeah!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, the next DM says...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<Dear MORE MORE JUMP!
I'd like to congratulate you all for successfully putting on your first solo show! I was very impressed that you had put on the event all on your own!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <As it so happens, my company produces a diet supplement called “Super Weight Loss Beauty DX” which allows you to lose 30 kg by taking it each day, and we'd like for you to all advertise it...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: L-Lose 30 kg?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Won't you vanish into thin air if you take enough of those...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You know it's a straight-up scam, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If you wanna lose weight, you gotta eat right and get plenty of exercise. There's no such thing as magic diet pills.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Right...
For a second there, I was amazed by how a product like that might be out there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Unfortunately, from what I've seen, a lot of the messages we got are pretty shady...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Again, before we accept any offers, we need to know who's sending us these offers. If we're not careful, things could get ugly fast.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Us falling victim is one thing, but if we ended up advertising such unwholesome products... I'd really rather not bring harm to anyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me neither.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Going through all these messages is hard enough. Weeding out the bad ones is just extra work on top of that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Doing this makes me realize just how important managers are.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But it's not all bad!
We've gotten some good ones, so let's try to be optimistic!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The next one says...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, mind if I also have a look?
Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <I apologize for contacting you so suddenly like this. I work as the producer for “idol Hazard” which is currently airing on Tokyo NX.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whaaat?!?!
The producer for iHaz?!?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you scared me there...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-Sorry, Shizuku!
I was so startled that...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh?
“iHaz”...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Have you heard of it, Airi?!
Like this person said, it's a show that airs on Tokyo NX late at night!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Its full title is “idol Hazard”, but everyone calls it “iHaz”! The MC changes each time since they ask various idols from all these different groups to lead the show...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It only started airing recently, but a lot of people have been praising it because you get to see all these guest groups interacting with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, the producer for this show contacting us must mean...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...!
What if...? Just what if...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Sh-Shizuku!
Please, keep reading!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: O-Okay, umm...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <I've actually been watching some of your streams, and my interest in your group has only grown since hearing how you successfully put on your very first solo show.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Since then, I've been watching the archive footage of your streams. The fun energy you all exude has become a great source of encouragement for me.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <I'd really like it if you could share some of that energy with our viewers by appearing on our program.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No way! It's a real offer to really appear on TV...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Mind if I take a look at that...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see...
In short, they want us to appear for their five-minute segment where they feature idols who are currently trending.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-Th-This is so cool...!
We might get to be on TV...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: More importantly, this is an amazing opportunity to get our name out there and have more people learn about us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree. I know it's just a five-minute appearance, but talk about hitting the jackpot.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd like to accept as well!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How about you, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This producer's pretty famous and sounds very sincere, so I think it's safe to say that it's a real offer.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Not only that, this is a huge chance for us. I was expecting to start with much smaller offers before tackling something so big...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But a huge opportunity like this is...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like some time to think about it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Care to explain why?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm not sure if appearing on TV is what we should be doing right now...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, a TV appearance may expand our fan base. We've gained a nice following online through our streams, but TV is on a completely different level.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But that has its drawbacks.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Drawbacks...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What I'm trying to say is that there may be unexpected consequences.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What if something one of us says is taken out of context for the purposes of entertainment? Sure, the show may benefit from that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we'd end up hurting our fans as a result.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course, I understand that not all TV programs are produced in such a way. There are many good things to be had...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But appearing on TV means being prepared for such things. That's why I'm having a hard time immediately accepting this offer...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, there's definitely a certain amount of risk involved...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Now that you mention it...
I remember this one time when they took one of my quips and edited it to make it look like I was bad-mouthing this actor that appeared with us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?! No way!
Was everything okay after that?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, things got pretty hectic after it aired. Some of that actor's fans still bring it up from time to time...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But my fans claimed, “Airi would never say stuff like that,” which helped keep things from really getting out of hand.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, despite what happened...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think the benefits of us appearing on TV outweigh the costs, so I'm in favor of accepting this offer.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Right...
Despite having a really bad experience, Airi's still in favor...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no! The bell rang!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Our lunch break's already over...
The time just flew by during this discussion.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, and we still haven't reached a consensus...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, let's all sleep on this and continue another time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sorry...
I didn't mean to rain on your parade. I know you're all excited about this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, don't say that.
Your opinions are just as valid as ours, so thank you for sharing with us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
She's right!
For stuff like this, we should all be in agreement before we accept or reject...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Because it's all for one and one for all with MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Precisely...
So, Haruka, feel free to speak your mind. You don't have to hold anything back from us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I'll give what we discussed some more thought.

source: https://storage.sekai.best/sekai-en-assets/event_story/…（SEKAI master database + SEKAI Viewer 资源，官方文本）
